verdict.rationale: Resend has a public pricing page. It describes a managed dedicated IP add-on (warmup, monitoring, autoscaling), SSO, and a self-serve add-on on Pro and Scale that users can add or remove without contacting sales, and community comments confirm published monthly plans. However, the excerpts show no actual per-volume tier prices, overage rates, or dollar costs for add-ons. Missing for 10: published per-volume tier prices, overage rates, explicit dedicated IP pricing, email validation add-on pricing, independent confirmation that pricing can be fully calculated without a sales call.
